body:
Update unitFor and unitsForIssue in packages/backlog-groom/lib/cluster.mjs so overlapping unit globs resolve by specificity rather than declaration order and verified paths that match no unit prevent unitsForIssue from claiming a single unique unit.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Overlapping unit globs resolve to the most specific matching glob regardless of declaration order, and equal-specificity overlaps across distinct units are treated as ambiguous. Verify: node --test packages/backlog-groom/test/cluster.test.mjs
2. When an issue has both a verified path in a unit and a verified path matching no unit, unitsForIssue does not return a single-unit match so relabelProposals and clusterIssues do not misattribute the issue to one unit. Verify: node --test packages/backlog-groom/test/cluster.test.mjs packages/backlog-groom/test/relabel.test.mjs
title: backlog-groom: resolve overlapping unit globs by specificity and preserve unassigned paths (#1038)
